main.description: Request a VM through the compute contract gateway. Gateway builds cloud-init from sshPublicKey, creates compute.vm and market.rfp records, discovers bidders, runs the full RFP protocol, submits accept, and verifies the receipt. Returns receipt refs and websocatUrl for SSH access.

computeVm.description: Compute VM specification (cpus, mem, disk, network, role). user_data is populated by the gateway from sshPublicKey.

sshPublicKey.description: OpenSSH public key for root SSH access to the VM.

vmReadyTimeoutSec.description: Seconds to wait for SSH readiness after provisioning.

execProgram.description: Program to execute over SSH after VM is ready.

skipSsh.description: Skip SSH session after contract. When true, returns immediately after receipt.

keepVm.description: Skip VM teardown after contract completion.

policy.description: Fulfillment policy to mint and attach to the RFP.

policyEngine.description: DID of a remote policy engine. When set, the minted policy record is a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.policies.service instead of policies.builtin.

extraBidderDids.description: Additional bidder DIDs beyond relay discovery.

name.description: Registry name of the policy to run (for example only-me, tangled-vouch, mutuals).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this policy admits.

args.description: Arguments passed to the policy. Well-known keys: bidWindowSec, firstFree.
